command:
import hashlib,importlib.metadata as m,json,pathlib,zerorun
p=pathlib.Path(zerorun.__file__).resolve().parent
rows=[{'path':f.name,'bytes':f.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for f in sorted(p.glob('*.py'))]
print(json.dumps({'version':m.version('zerorun'),'module':str(p),'files':rows},sort_keys=True))

The selected unittest target reads bound tests/c_files fixtures (including legacy rU reads); all parser modules, generated tables, tests and configuration are inputs. No selected-test external communication was found. Inspection covers these two exact recorded source states, the fixed target, all literal top-level inputs and the existing Python 3.10.21/pytest 8.4.2 digest image. Execution is containerized with network disabled, source inputs read-only, no forwarded host environment, no reusable output artifacts and result-only caching. This bounded assessment is not a proof of arbitrary future behavior.
